FDA posts the amoxicillin and clavulanate potassium shortage

explanation.headline: FDA's shortage list shows amoxicillin and clavulanate potassium has been posted since 2022-10-28; NuCare and Asclemed plants have VAI/OAI histories but no current FDA cause is stated

sentences.text: FDA's shortage list shows amoxicillin and clavulanate potassium has been posted since 2022-10-28 and remains listed as of 2026-10-21, a duration of 48 months.
NuCare Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (FEI 3003294404) is a registered relabel plant for this product and its most recent FDA inspection ended 2020-01-10 with a VAI classification.
Asclemed USA Inc. DBA ENOVACHEM (FEI 3001452204) is another registered relabel plant and received an OAI classification after an inspection ending 2018-09-27.
FDA has not stated a cause for the shortage in the provided records.
Corvale East holds 294 units at 15.3 units per day (19 days on hand) and Corvale General holds 823 units at 30.8 units per day (27 days on hand).
The rule-ranked option is to buy from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc., which is not on FDA's shortage list today and operates plants in Jordan (2INAMOXU24N-E and 2INAMOXU12N).
Alternate manufacturers not on the shortage list include Sandoz Inc. and Teva Pharmaceuticals USA, Inc., which should also be checked for availability.

Q-16e906.sql: SELECT s.hospital, s.item_key, s.ndc11, s.ndc_as_recorded, s.description, s.on_hand, s.daily_use, s.unit, s.ndc_match, p.generic_name, p.labeler_name, p.package_ndc, p.spl_set_id, p.dosage_form, p.route FROM (SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_general UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_east UNION ALL SELECT * FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.stock_lakeside) s LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = s.ndc11 WHERE lower(coalesce(p.generic_name, '')) LIKE '%amoxicillin%' OR lower(s.description) LIKE '%amoxicillin%' ORDER BY s.hospital, s.item_key

Q-43008f.sql: SELECT ps.set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, ps.est_operations, ps.site_source, st.fei, st.firm_name, st.country_iso3, st.address FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE ps.set_id IN ('30144e2e-d336-8fa3-e063-6394a90a6068', '830bb8fb-3743-463a-9317-3f83e3e105ac') ORDER BY ps.set_id, ps.establishment

Q-c61798.sql: SELECT generic_name, company_name, status, package_ndc, initial_posting_date, update_date, substr(related_info, 1, 220) AS related_info FROM fda.shortage_current WHERE lower(generic_name) LIKE '%amoxicillin%' ORDER BY status, company_name, package_ndc

Q-893db9.sql: SELECT generic, category, first_posting, first_seen, last_seen, resolved_first_seen, statuses, n_companies, reasons FROM fda.shortage_episodes WHERE lower(generic) LIKE '%amoxicillin%' ORDER BY first_posting

Q-f0fb37.sql: SELECT p.ndc11, p.package_ndc, p.labeler_name, p.dosage_form, p.spl_set_id, ps.establishment, ps.est_duns, st.fei, st.country_iso3 FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product_site ps ON ps.set_id = p.spl_set_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.site st ON st.duns = ps.est_duns WHERE lower(p.generic_name) LIKE '%amoxicillin%' AND lower(p.dosage_form) LIKE '%powder%' ORDER BY p.labeler_name, p.ndc11

Q-a3c5b9.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, legal_name, country, end_date, classification, known_date, known_date_basis FROM lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.inspection WHERE fei IN ('3003294404', '3001452204', '3004446312') ORDER BY fei, end_date

Q-9e5734.sql: SELECT fei, legal_name, country, action_date, action_type, case_id FROM fda.compliance_actions WHERE fei IN ('3003294404', '3001452204', '3004446312') ORDER BY fei, action_date

Q-d17fa2.sql: SELECT alert, country, firm, address, date_published, fei, fei_match, firm_key FROM fda.import_alerts WHERE fei IN ('3003294404', '3001452204') OR (fei_match <> 'name_and_city' AND firm_key IN ('nucare', 'asclemed dba enovachem')) ORDER BY date_published

Q-24784a.sql: SELECT recall_number, recalling_firm, firm_key, country, classification, status, initiation_date, report_date, substr(reason, 1, 220) AS reason, substr(product_description, 1, 160) AS product_description FROM fda.recalls WHERE firm_key IN ('nucare', 'asclemed dba enovachem', 'asclemed') AND initiation_date >= '2020-01-01' AND lower(product_description) LIKE '%amoxicillin%' ORDER BY initiation_date

Q-a01d46.sql: SELECT inspection_id, fei, end_date, cfr, short_description FROM fda.citations WHERE inspection_id IN ('1067059') ORDER BY inspection_id, cfr

Q-7cd6ec.sql: SELECT a.ndc11 AS ndc11, a.generic_name AS item, b.ndc11 AS alt_ndc11, b.generic_name AS alternative, b.strength AS alt_strength, ti.rule, ti.approved_by, ti.approved_on, ti.notes, p.labeler_name AS alt_labeler FROM corvale_general.therapeutic_interchange ti JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item a ON a.item_id = ti.item_id JOIN corvale_general.formulary_item b ON b.item_id = ti.alt_item_id LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.upstream.upstream_usl.product p ON p.ndc11 = b.ndc11 WHERE a.ndc11 IN ('68071380701', '76420081950')
